title: Rabbi Shmuel bar Tzadok
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Yuchasin and Seder HaDorot give no source location for him. Hyman writes that he found Rabbi Shmuel ben Yehotzadak in Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot, chapter 3, at the end of halakhah 1. In the Rif, at the end of Shabbat chapter 4, with the printed locator 51a, the name is R”Sh bar Tzadok; the Gemara reads R”Sh bar Yitzchak.

notes.text: The two variant names in the Rif/Gemara comparison are abbreviated R”Sh in the supplied text.

The consulted Rif text spells out Rav Shmuel bar Tzadok. The consulted Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 3:1 reads Shimon ben Yotzadak and separately mentions Shmuel bar Rav Yitzchak. The notice’s attribution to Shmuel ben Yehotzadak remains Hyman’s report.
